name: nearby-donor-v1
purpose: Freeze city roles and eligibility rules before imagery export or any new-city model scores. Training recipe and exact matched label budget are frozen separately after screening and the reconstruction diagnostic.

zadar.training: All screened tiles satisfying the within-city and historical separation audit form the eligible pool; the matched study uses a frozen subset.

sibenik.training: None; no model or reconstruction choices use this city.

split-v2.role: reused transfer development geography; no confirmation claim

zagreb-v2.role: matched distant donor using nested source-only subsets

eligibility.screening: Existing parcel-count, coverage, overlap and imagery-no-data screens, unchanged. No model output participates.
eligibility.historical_exposure: All eleven inventoried city/pool/dataset manifests, including previous training, selection, final and diagnostic geography, plus cross-checks between the new cities.
eligibility.geography_choice: Each listed extension was declared before querying it because the compact coastal core had fragile density/block coverage. Stop at these unions; a failure is reported before any alternate geography is chosen.
eligibility.post_export_audit: Verify actual image/truth/OSM hashes, true density bins, complete source-ID and bbox separation, final tile lists and zero confirmation-city training/selection exposure before training.

future_comparison.recipe: One common recipe selected from the preceding bounded diagnostic/training stage; no concurrent encoder, loss, preprocessing or resolution change in the donor comparison.
future_comparison.selection: Each donor uses only its own development blocks for checkpoint and reconstruction selection. Freeze the complete comparison before Split outcomes and before any confirmation scoring.
future_comparison.budget: Match annotated label budget and training updates prospectively; record actual tile, parcel-instance and unique-source counts for each fit. Freeze the exact subset algorithm and counts after screening, before training.
future_comparison.confirmation: Use the reconstruction-v3 development and fresh-confirmation gates. Keep the confirmation city unscored unless the predeclared development gate passes and the full compared policies are frozen.
future_comparison.interpretation: A regional donor advantage bundles geography, cadastral fabric and imagery programme; it does not isolate climate or establish global transfer.
future_comparison.spending: Use the existing prepaid GPU balance only, after a fresh balance/offer check and bounded rental plan.
